repository.commit_message: v0.1.0-rc1: Complete Stage 0-14 pipeline, replay API, and frontend integration baseline

GATE_0_REPOSITORY_IDENTITY.evidence: Single root commit 5d8abce identified as v0.1.0-rc1. Baseline contradiction resolved: 5d8abce is git root commit; implementation lives in working tree.

GATE_1_FROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_BASELINE.evidence: Pytest full suite: 523 passed, 1 warning in 73.84s. Dataset checksum c8ed7d9c92a0c337f859bcd0374c46e8a4f431a7d37e7257d81dc38a43d4b4d9 verified.

GATE_2_FRONTEND_BASELINE_RECONCILIATION.evidence: Frontend test suite: 68 passed, 0 failed in 3.56s. 60 baseline tests preserved unchanged; 8 additive tests (61-68) added for face presence, judge steps, audio feedback, and truth firewall.

GATE_3_BUILD_RECONCILIATION.evidence: 3 production builds executed: Cold=1.84s, Warm-1=935ms, Warm-2=415ms, Final=810ms. Exit code 0. JS: 1006.12 kB (gzip 263.99 kB), CSS: 45.00 kB (gzip 9.11 kB), HTML: 0.45 kB (gzip 0.29 kB).

GATE_4_VOICE_FORENSICS.evidence: Browser SpeechRecognition instantiated with continuous=false, interimResults=false. onresult executes executeUtterance(). stopListening() stops media stream tracks.

GATE_5_AUDIO_FEEDBACK.evidence: RealtimeAudio muted gain node (gain=0) connects processorNode to audioCtx.destination, preventing speaker feedback loop and false barge-in.

GATE_6_PROVIDER_SEPARATION.evidence: BrowserSpeech operates independently of raw PCM provider.sendAudio(). Without GEMINI_API_KEY, status displays 'VOICE BACKEND — NOT CONFIGURED'.

GATE_7_GEMINI_LIVE.evidence: GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable is not configured in local environment. Blocked by environment.

GATE_8_DIAGNOSTICS.evidence: Agent and Full Pipeline diagnostics PASS in 2ms. Physical hardware diagnostics (Mic, SpeechRec, TTS) correctly report BLOCKED in headless Node environment.

GATE_9_CONTEXT.evidence: All 6 contextual query transitions ('Show me E-102' -> 'Why?' -> 'What\'s missing?' -> 'What should I investigate next?' -> 'Show me that.' -> 'Frame it in 3D.') passed state verification.

GATE_10_INTERRUPTION.evidence: VAD barge-in stopped playback in 0.179ms; manual interrupt stopped in 0.006ms. Background countdown task survived uninterrupted.

GATE_11_CANCELLATION.evidence: 'Cancel.' cancels scheduled timer task. 'Stop speaking.' terminates TTS while preserving scheduled timer task. Unambiguous tool mapping.

GATE_12_FACE_PRESENCE.evidence: Presence-only boolean. Zero embeddings, zero templates, zero biometric DB, zero cloud uploads, default OFF. Debounce: 3 positive frames (450ms), 5 negative frames (750ms).

GATE_13_FACE_ACTIVATION.evidence: One-turn wake activation per confirmed presence. Camera requests only after explicit ARMED action. Shuts down cleanly on OFF.

GATE_14_TRUTH_FIREWALL.evidence: All 4 illegitimate truth upgrades (INFERRED->OBSERVED, SIMULATED->OBSERVED, UNAVAILABLE->OBSERVED, REPRESENTATIVE->AS-BUILT CAD) and fabricated unmeasured properties (viscosity, delta-P) rejected.

GATE_15_FOULX.evidence: Supported case (NORMAL, t=100) produces GateStatus.PASS and DecisionState.OPERATE. +6σ shifted case (SHIFTED, t=100) produces GateStatus.ABSTAIN, DecisionState.ABSTAIN, reason code REGIME_OOD, and fixed-policy fallback.

GATE_16_2D_GRAPH_3D.evidence: Asset selection E-102 synchronized across P&ID, Process Graph, 3D, Inspector, Evidence. Selection of E-103 completely purges stale selection. 3D explicitly displays 'Representative Inferred Geometry — Not As-Built CAD' and CAD SOURCE: UNAVAILABLE.

GATE_17_JUDGE_MODE.evidence: All 19 steps executed against real state and passed verification in docs/FINAL_JUDGE_RUN.json and docs/FINAL_JUDGE_RUN.md.

GATE_18_ACTUAL_BROWSER_ACCEPTANCE.evidence: Browser automation driver unavailable: Playwright binary download failed due to 404 from upstream CDN (playwright.azureedge.net). No browser executable installed in PATH.

GATE_19_SECURITY_RELEASE.evidence: Zero secrets or API keys detected in production dist bundle. All 6 prohibited actuator commands (Open valve, Set pump speed, Change setpoint, Shutdown plant, Modify PLC, Modify DCS) strictly rejected.
